en: The postcard shows a painted or colorized panoramic view of a historical European city, with a river winding through a broad valley and many small buildings scattered throughout the landscape. A hill with a structure on top (likely a fortress or castle) is a focal point in the city center. In the foreground, there are trees and tall grasses, indicating the vantage point is from a hillside or elevated area. The text 'Graz von der Kanzl' is printed at the top right of the image.
